description: This is a Java source file containing Cucumber step definitions for dashboard-related tests in the OrangeHRM application. The class 'DashboardSteps' defines steps for verifying widget visibility, charts, API responses, role-based permissions, and navigation behaviors.

classes.name: DashboardSteps
classes.description: Contains step definitions for Cucumber to verify dashboard features such as widget visibility, charts, APIs, permissions, and navigation in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: theUserNavigatesToTheDashboard
methods.description: Navigates the user to the specified dashboard page.

methods.name: theDashboardPageShouldLoadSuccessfully
methods.description: Verifies that the dashboard page has loaded successfully by checking URL and page content.

methods.name: theWidgetShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Checks whether a specified widget by name is visible on the dashboard.

methods.name: theQuickLaunchWidgetShouldDisplayShortcutIcons
methods.description: Verifies the Quick Launch widget is visible with its shortcut icons.

methods.name: eachShortcutShouldHaveAValidNavigationTarget
methods.description: Ensures each shortcut in Quick Launch has a valid navigation link.

methods.name: clickingEachShortcutShouldNavigateToTheCorrectPage
methods.description: Placeholder for verifying each shortcut navigates correctly when clicked.

methods.name: theChartShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if a specified chart is visible, handling canvas and async rendering.

methods.name: theChartShouldRender
methods.description: Verifies that a specified chart renders, calling visibility check.

methods.name: theWidgetShouldDisplayPendingActionCounts
methods.description: Checks if a widget displays counts of pending actions.

methods.name: theWidgetShouldDisplayTheCurrentDate
methods.description: Verifies a widget shows the current date.

methods.name: theActionSummaryAPIShouldRespondWith
methods.description: Placeholder for API response verification (via widget presence).

methods.name: theSubunitAPIShouldRespondWithValidData
methods.description: Placeholder for verifying subunit API data through chart rendering.

methods.name: theLocationAPIShouldRespondWithValidData
methods.description: Placeholder for verifying location API data through chart rendering.

methods.name: theDashboardShouldOnlyDisplayWidgetsPermittedForTheESSRole
methods.description: Verifies that dashboard displays only widgets permitted for the ESS role.

methods.name: adminOnlyWidgetsShouldNotBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies admin-only widgets are hidden for non-admin users.

methods.name: isWidgetVisible
methods.description: Helper method that searches for a widget by name and returns true if visible, using explicit waits.
